pages.text: The Purifier Matrix is a standalone bulk-refining multiblock; it is not a Purifier enclosed in walls. A new 3×3×3 sealed cavity is built from Purifier Matrix Casing.$(br2)$(bold)Wall checklist:$(reset)$(li)Casing: fill walls, floor and ceiling with Purifier Matrix Casing$(li)Place the controller on any face$(li)Add an Energy Input Port$(li)Add an Item Input Port and an Item Output Port$(li)The cavity must remain empty$(br2)Once formed, the controller refines in bulk: Raw Akaishi Block → $(bold)1 essence$(reset), Akaishi Crystal Block → $(bold)4 essence$(reset), all at $(bold)30x speed$(reset).

$(bold)How it shares work with the Purifier:$(reset)$(li)The single-block Purifier has its own fuel slot and can operate without a grid$(li)The Purifier Matrix has no fuel slot; it runs entirely on power from the Energy Input Port, so the grid must be built first$(li)Feedstock enters through the Item Input Port and essence exits via the Item Output Port; connecting Item Pipes automates the line$(br2)$(bold)When to upgrade:$(reset) build the matrix when raw blocks begin to queue in front of a single Purifier. Each batch costs 500 energy, and its throughput exceeds any single machine.

Start with the single-block $(l:akaishi:purifier)Akaishi Purifier$(/l); the shared sealed-cavity rules are in $(l:akaishi:matrix)Matrix Structures$(/l); power and logistics use $(l:akaishi:energy_pipe)Energy Pipes$(/l) and $(l:akaishi:item_pipe)Item Pipes$(/l).
